correctness.rationale: FARL adjunction/interiority force extensive idempotent g and common fixed set D with unique floor/ceiling f,g. Implication and both Frobenius laws force a nonzero axis point to give rectangle; absent axis point forces strict coordinate synchronization. Converse checks axioms for both shapes, and Vandermonde counts 2^(m+n-4)+C(m+n-4,m-2). Independent exhaustive all 4^8 map pairs for C2×C2 yielded exactly 2.
residual_risks: Case distinctions for m,n>=2 only; no claim for more than two factors or isomorphism count. Small brute-force not global proof.
